title: Messaging tabs are shared; content is keyed by MessagingNavTabKey in WorkflowsScene
answers: How do I add a new messaging tab (Library, Channels, Opt-outs...)?
Why is a tab blank on the Workflows page?
Where are the tabs shown on both Broadcasts and Workflows pages defined?
body:
Tab definitions (label, key, link) live once in products/workflows/frontend/messagingTabs.tsx `messagingNavTabs()`; keys are typed by `MessagingNavTabKey`.
- WorkflowsScene renders them with content via `MESSAGING_TAB_CONTENT: Record<MessagingNavTabKey, JSX.Element>` in WorkflowsScene.tsx.
- BroadcastsScene renders them as plain links to `/workflows/<tab>` (no content).
- Adding a key without an entry in `MESSAGING_TAB_CONTENT` fails typecheck, by design; also add it to `WORKFLOW_SCENE_TABS` so the route works.
Content stays in WorkflowsScene because those tab links open there.
